news.title: After 11 World Cups, football finally comes home for one Indian fan
news.lede: Brazil's Danilo Santos (right) and his teammates attend a training session ahead of the international friendly football match against India in Kolkata. (AFP pic) KOLKATA: From Diego Maradona's infamous "Hand of God" to Zinedine Zidane's headbutt, Indian football fan Dipak Nandy has witnessed some of the World Cup's defining moments from the stands. However, on Saturday, the 77-year-old will savour a rare sporting occasion from the comfort of his hometown Kolkata, where Brazil take on his home country in their first-ever international friendly. Nandy, who has travelled far and wide to attend 11 World Cups, will take in this particular match in front of the television.

news.title: Egypt start without Salah, Uruguay at full strength
news.lede: YEKATERINBURG, Russia (Reuters) - Egypt will start without Mohamed Salah in their World Cup opener against a full-strength Uruguay on Friday, in a setback for millions of Egyptians who are pinning their tournament hopes on the Liverpool striker. Coach Hector Cuper decided not to risk his talisman despite telling reporters on Thursday that Salah had responded well to treatment on the shoulder injury he sustained in the Champions League final last month and was nearly 100 percent certain to play in Egypt's first appearance at the finals for 28 years. It was not clear if he would come on as a substitute or whether Cuper would save him for the later group games against Russia and Saudi Arabia. Salah, who turned 26 on Friday, came out with other players to inspect the pitch in Yekaterinburg.

news.title: Thomas Tuchel's Trent Alexander-Arnold treatment reveals England fear that led to World Cup failure
news.lede: How do you solve a problem like Trent Alexander-Arnold? To start with, it’s probably best to acknowledge that there might not be that much of a problem at all. The England and Real Madrid defender/midfielder/playmaker/nobody-quite-knows-what-er made his first start under Thomas Tuchel against Czechia on Tuesday and proved the difference in creating the first goal to break down a stubborn defence just after half-time. Trent, as he likes to be called these days, has always confused England fans and pundits alike.

news.title: When FIFA will decide World Cup 2030 final venue amid Camp Nou, Bernabeu uncertainty
news.lede: FIFA is reportedly not expected to decide the venue for the 2030 World Cup final until 2028, leaving the race between Morocco and Spain open as preparations.

news.title: Ancelotti says Brazil 'respects' India ahead of showdown
news.lede: KOLKATA: Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti said Friday his team held respect for hosts India ahead of a first-ever international friendly between the sides.
